welcome.label: Introduction
welcome.demoNote: The example is three months of one learner's history and can be removed from settings in one step.

chat.title: Chat
chat.body: Ask about anything you are trying to understand. Study mode guides thinking and practice; free chat is an ordinary exchange.

map.title: Map
map.body: Every concept that comes up in conversation is organised onto a map as an island, positioned and grouped automatically.

discovery.title: Discover
discovery.body: Watch Bilibili and YouTube as usual. With the script installed, what was watched is gathered here, and interests find their way in.

library.title: My material
library.body: Import your own material; answers are searched for in it first.

companions.title: Companions
companions.body: A few companions come to ask about what was recently learned, and it is your turn to explain.

memory.title: Memory
memory.body: Islands left untouched for a long time fade, showing which parts have been set aside for a while.

start.title: Start
start.body: Conversations, the map and material stay on this computer. Example data can be loaded first, to see what three months look like.

hints.label: Feature hint
hints.chatMode: Study mode guides thinking and practice; free chat is an ordinary exchange.
hints.composer: Type a question here; the concepts the conversation covers are organised onto the map automatically.
hints.chatLinks: A chat can be linked to documents in My material; answers then draw on those documents first.
hints.groundingMark: The dot at the end of a sentence marks its source; click it to read the original.
hints.mapFirstIsland: Islands form from the concepts that came up in conversation; islands left untouched for a long time fade.
hints.discoveryScript: One script is for Bilibili and one for YouTube, each installed once; after that, browse as usual and what was watched is gathered on this page automatically.
hints.libraryImport: Imported material stays on this computer; a question is searched for in it first, then answered by the AI.
hints.settingsApi: Enter the address and key of an AI service here; the key stays on this computer.

settings.title: Getting started
settings.hint: The introduction can be played again, every feature hint brought back, and the example data removed.
settings.hintsRestored: Reset. Each feature shows its hint once more the next time it is on screen.
